name: Futanari Planet
source:
You travel with Andrea through space. Andrea is a female android with a huge penis. Your story together is romantic and free of jealousy

Suddenly, a space accident sends you both into a place beyond space and time. It looks like you've arrived on planet Venus!  But... there's water here and the temperature is perfect!

There, you'll meet space pirates, peaceful aliens, and even a rather bored she-devil (though the idea of seducing you seems to amuse her) 

On this planet, every woman has tits and a penis. What a fun planet!

Find your way back home, or stay on this planet 🛸🪐

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5203610/Futanari_Planet/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
